Silvercrest Asset Management Group Decreased Its Sap Se Spon Adr (SAP) Holding by $609,840; Market Valuation Declined; American Axle & Mfg Hldgs In (AXL) Holding Has Upped by Whitebox Advisors Llc
May 21, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Silvercrest Asset Management Group Llc decreased its stake in Sap Se Spon Adr (SAP) by 12.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Silvercrest Asset Management Group Llc sold 5,445 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.48% with the market. The hedge fund held 38,660 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.34M, down from 44,105 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Silvercrest Asset Management Group Llc who had been investing in Sap Se Spon Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $134.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.37% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $113.24. About 1.22M shares traded or 32.54% up from the average. SAP SE (NYSE:SAP) has risen 5.83% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.72% the S&P500.
Andy Redleaf increased its stake in American Axle & Mfg Hldgs In (AXL) by 167.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Whitebox Advisors Llc bought 47,791 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.90% with the market. The hedge fund run by Andy Redleaf held 76,314 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.30 million, up from 28,523 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whitebox Advisors Llc who had been investing in American Axle & Mfg Hldgs In for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.80 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $16.12. About 1.27M shares traded. American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:AXL) has declined 17.15% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.70% the S&P500.

Analysts await SAP SE (NYSE:SAP) to report earnings on July, 19. They expect $0.98 EPS, up 28.95% or $0.22 from last year’s $0.76 per share. SAP’s profit will be $1.16B for 28.89 P/E if the $0.98 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.82 actual EPS reported by SAP SE for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 19.51% EPS growth.
